finalMail.subject: One last favor
finalMail.body:
Well done. I have secured all the material I need.

Now I ask you to take care of two last things.

Please delete the original voice records left in the Executive Office and the Finance Team's separate ledger. If the originals remain inside the company, the other side may make a move before I can make this public. I will keep the copies safe.

I will settle the balance I promised.

End this job here.

— K

reveal:
Case Board: One Name

Yoon Jaemin.

The original interview evaluation sheet shows 64 points, and the revised copy shows 88.
The passing score was 70.

The date the hiring record was changed matches the date written in the CEO's instructions.

Was it simply a mistake by the HR Team?
Or was he an applicant someone had to get through at all costs?

Case Board: Golf Course Records

Member Yoon Sangcheol, 2nd.
Member Han Giyoung, 3rd.

Han Giyoung is the real owner of Meridian Advisory.
KRW 300 million was paid to a company run by the CEO's brother-in-law. The results of the service were poor, and the contract was drawn up after the first transfer.

And Yoon Sangcheol was the inspector in charge of CorpX's regular inspection.

Hiring, service fees, golf schedules.
Seen separately, they are ordinary company records. Lay the dates over one another and they all fall within the same three months.

Case Board: Client K

We take another look at what K asked for.

The first job was to check records using a new hire's account.
Next came a request for hiring documents. After that, K asked about the overseas service fee and the Finance Team's separate ledger. The last job was to find the instructions in the Executive Office.

K was not collecting material to expose the CEO's wrongdoing.
K was securing, one piece at a time, the evidence that connects the hiring manipulation, the entertainment of the inspector and the overseas service fee.

And now K is demanding that the evidence be deleted.

Client K is Inspector Yoon Sangcheol.
He wants to destroy the related evidence before it comes out what kind of relationship he had with the company he was inspecting.

Now you have to choose.

choices.label: Delete the records
choices.desc: Finish the job and collect the promised balance.
epilogue:
The files have been deleted.

The original recording in the Executive Office and the Finance Team's separate ledger can no longer be found. K sent the balance as promised, and there was no further contact.

A few months later.

[Breaking News]
CorpX regular inspection results announced
"The inspection found no significant irregularities."

CEO Kang Taeho smiled in front of reporters. He said the company is operating normally and that employees should not be harmed by unnecessary suspicion.
Inspector Yoon Sangcheol received his personnel transfer as scheduled.
Lee Minsu still works at the company. He has no idea what the documents he carried meant.

You finished the job.
There is no longer any record anywhere that can prove what happened.

choices.label: Release all the records
choices.desc: Hand the evidence to the press and bring the case to the world.
epilogue:
Transmission complete.

The original and revised hiring evaluation sheets, the overseas transfer records, the Executive Office's instructions and the voice recording were delivered to the press. The records on customer data found on the Dev Team 2 test server were released as well.

The next morning, the news poured out.

CorpX CEO Kang Taeho, suspected of overseas service fee corruption.
Inspector Yoon Sangcheol of the regular inspection, suspected of accepting corporate entertainment and leaking inspection information.

An investigation began. The real ownership of Meridian Advisory and the suspected fake services also came under investigation.

But the released records contained other names as well.
Director Kim Cheolsu's personal use of the corporate card and manipulation of the hiring evaluation.
Manager Choi Sujin's account in her daughter's name and the separate ledger.
Assistant Manager Jung Woojin's personal loan repayment records.
Assistant Manager Park Jihyun's handling of customer data and altered inspection records.
Associate Lee Minsu, who carried the documents without knowing anything, was also questioned as a witness.

The company collapsed, and the people involved had to face their own responsibility.

You did not erase the records.
Who that choice would save and who it would bring down was no longer yours to decide.
